spawn_threshold.decision_rule: spawn only if EVERY positive condition holds AND NO negative condition holds; a doubt is a negative

positive_conditions.text: the side task would flood the parent conversation with search results, logs or file contents
positive_conditions.provenance: findings/05 Ф22 — first-party code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents (WebFetch 2026-07-29), quoted verbatim

positive_conditions.text: the parent needs only the condensed result, not the raw material itself
positive_conditions.provenance: findings/05 Ф20 — first-party anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system (WebFetch 2026-07-29): compression is the point, parallelism is the means

positive_conditions.text: the work has one objective statable in a single sentence with its own boundaries
positive_conditions.provenance: findings/05 Ф19 — first-party: an assignment without an objective and boundaries produces duplicated work and gaps

negative_conditions.text: the raw material WILL be needed by the parent on the following steps → do not spawn (mandatory row: this is the condition nothing in the repo records today)
negative_conditions.provenance: findings/05 Ф22 — first-party «content you won't reference again»: the negation of the reuse clause is a direct contra-indication

negative_conditions.text: the task is deciding, integrating or contracting (architecture, ADR, contract verdict) rather than gathering
negative_conditions.provenance: findings/05, cross-check paragraph: «use a subagent for gather/analyze/summarize, keep the main session for decide/integrate/continue»

negative_conditions.text: one edit in one layer or one file — do it directly
negative_conditions.provenance: RAG:— repo-grounded: packages/harness/configs/common/agent-packs/roles.json _common.orchestrator § «Порог делегирования», the rule already canonical in the role body

subjects.provenance: findings/04 Ф17 · first-party code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents (WebFetch 2026-07-29): 200 per session (v2.1.212+), 20 concurrent (v2.1.217+), nesting depth 3 (v2.1.219). Platform ceiling, not our measurement; env-tunable by the operator.

subjects.provenance: findings/04 Ф17 · first-party, same page: agents spawned by a workflow script do not count against the session budget; the runtime caps ~16 concurrent (min(16, cores − 2), so 16 is an upper bound) and 1 000 per run. Outside our control.

fleet_cap.condition: file-independent tasks only; concurrent writers to one working tree are never authorised

allowed_agent_roles.rule: allowed = every (pack_id, role_id) present in the canon for the packs installed in the project, minus exclusions; a role absent from the canon MUST NOT be addressed by a PLAN line
